throws ERR_OPTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for the ALPNProtocols, enableTrace, minDHSize and pskCallback options, and for rejectUnauthorized: false. It throws for checkServerIdentity only while the throw_on_not_implemented_tls_options flag is on. That flag is on from compatibility date 2026-06-16, and no_throw_on_not_implemented_tls_options turns it off. edgefit uses your date and flags for checkServerIdentity

notes: The tedious driver uses UDP for a named instance, and @azure/identity starts a browser with child_process, and a Worker cannot do either. Tedious calls an @azure/identity credential only after a SQL Server accepts the login, so a run without one cannot reach the child_process calls. The UDP lookup for a named instance does not throw on workerd, and the connection times out.
